IRS990.Desc: COMMUNICATIONS - In 2024, Animal Equalitys Communications and Marketing team delivered powerful results across media, digital engagement, and fundraising, expanding the organizations reach and deepening public awareness of animal protection issues.The team secured 70 earned media mentions in the U.S. alone, reaching an estimated 317 million peoplean 89% increase over the previous year. Highlights included a co-authored piece in Reuters and coverage in Vox, Plant Based News, Mashed, and Current Affairs.Efforts to elevate Love Veg, Animal Equalitys plant-based living resource, led to a full website revamp and consistent, high-quality weekly content. Paid social media advertising fueled growth, with an 8.5x increase in monthly subscribers. Across platforms, Animal Equalitys social media generated over 1.7 million engagements and a record 2.9 million video views.Marketing and fundraising strategies exceeded expectations. The team surpassed lead generation goals by 6%, achieving a cost per lead of just $1.73well below industry benchmarks. Online campaigns significantly outperformed sector norms, with online donations from new leads making up nearly 20% of total contributions. Additionally, the average monthly gift was 30% higher than the industry standard, and the cost per donation remained below benchmark.Timely and strategic content releasesincluding newsletters, blogs, and social mediakept supporters informed and engaged in Animal Equalitys global work throughout the year.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: CAMPAIGNS - Animal Equality added a third campaigner to the US Campaigns team, in 2024.In 2024, Animal Equality secured a policy from Dennys restaurant chain regarding gestation crates for pigs after an intense campaign lasting 600 days. Animal Equality participated in cage-free campaigns with the Open Wing Alliance and secured policies from companies, including Kewpie Corp, Colombina, and Lai Sun Dining.We continued the Aldi campaign in collaboration with Animal Equality in Germany, ramping up pressure by protesting at new store opening events.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: INVESTIGATIONS - In 2024 Animal Equality presented 12 unique investigations filmed across our eight member countries. Shocking images of pig workers kicking, punching and stabbing piglets to death on a German pig farm were featured on one of the countries most respected news programs. Pigs at an Italian slaughterhouse were filmed standing, walking and gasping for breath after having their throats cut in violation of Italian cruelty laws. In India cows kept for milk production were documented being killed in open air markets after being dragged to the ground, bound and having their throats cut. In the United States two investigations were carried out one of which was later released in 2025. Animal Equality has spent considerable time developing professional standards for evidence management and analysis submitting our findings for veterinary, legal and legislative review in an ever expanding global capacity.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 12c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BOARD MEMBERS ABSTAIN FROM DISCUSSION AND VOTING ON ANY MATTERS THAT MAY RESULT IN A CONFLICT OF INTEREST. THE BOARD WILL ONLY DECIDE TO HIRE OR CONTRACT WITH THE BOARD MEMBERS IF THE GOODS OR SERVICES ARE NEEDED AND THE INDIVIDUAL IS THE MOST QUALIFIED AND PROVIDES THE BEST PRICE. IT IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE BOARD TO RECORD IN THE MINUTES OF THE BOARD MEETING THE POTENTIAL CONFLICT OF INTEREST. IN ADDITION, EACH BOARD MEMBER ISREQUIRED TO COMPLETE AND SIGN A CONFLICT OF INTEREST STATEMENT ON AN ANNUAL BASIS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15a
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ANIMAL EQUALITY'S BOARD OF DIRECTORS HAS A PROCESS FOR REVIEWING AND APPROVING THE COMPENSATION OF OFFICERS AND KEY EMPLOYEES ON A REGULAR BASIS TO DETERMINE IT IS FAIR AND REASONABLE WITH THE GOAL OF RETAINING EMPLOYEES AT COMPENSATION LEVELS WITHIN APPROPRIATE MARKET RANGE. THE PROCESS FOR DETERMINING THE COMPENSATION PAID TO THE CEO, OFFICERS, AND KEY EMPLOYEES INCLUDES THE APPROVAL OF THE COMPENSATION AGREEMENT IN ADVANCE, BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, WITH ALL PERSONS WITH A CONFLICT OF INTEREST ABSTAINING FROM THE BOARD'S DELIBERATION AND DISCUSSION. THE BOARD REVIEWS DATA OF COMPARABLE COMPENSATION FOR SIMILARLY QUALIFIED NONPROFIT EXECUTIVES AT SIMILARLY SITUATED ENTITIES.THE DOCUMENTATION OF THE BOARD INCLUDES THE TERMS OF THE TRANSACTION AND THE DATE OF APPROVAL, THE MEMBERS WHO WERE PRESENT DURING THE DEBATE AND VOTE ON THE TRANSACTION, A DESCRIPTION OF THE COMPARABLE DATA AND HOW IT WAS OBTAINED, AND DOCUMENTATION OF THE BASIS FOR THE DETERMINATION.
